messages:
Tess (CSE): Heads-up — LumenBridge flipped on two new org teams (Search + Agent Assist). Early telemetry shows combined bursts and a big nightly embed job; they're hitting embedding queue saturation and intermittent 429s. Renewal in ~40 days, they're worried about unpredictable monthly spend and want per-team isolation. cc @Arjun @Felix

Arjun (CS Ops): Can you share qps and batch sizes? realtime vs backfill?

Tess (CSE): Realtime: Search team ~50 seats, avg prompt ~900 tokens, peak ~3 req/s/seat. Agent Assist: ~35 seats, longer responses ~1.2k tokens, peak ~2 req/s/seat. Nightly backfill: 500k docs over 12h using embed-fast-xl with batch_size 512. Tenant qps steady ~300, bursts to ~850. Observed ~25 429s during the backfill window.

Felix (Eng-runtime): Likely worker saturation + KV churn. Short-term mitigations: 1) reduce backfill batch_size to 256, 2) add per-team concurrency caps, 3) route backfill to a dedicated ingest lane. For predictable bills and latency, recommend a Dedicated pool pilot. I'll open INF-10021 for a canary route + KV retention toggle.

Nora (AE): I'll propose a 10-day dedicated ingest + serving trial focused on Search. Need an estimate of GPU-hours for the backfill and an expected cost delta to present to finance. If trial shows <20% cost delta and >35% tail error reduction, we'll push for committed capacity at renewal.

Iris (Product): Noted product requests: per-team quota UI, per-team spend dashboard, and message-level team tags in audit logs. Tess, can you capture exact log fields they need? We'll add to backlog.

Tess (CSE): Will collect sample job id and log fields. Action items: Arjun -> OPS ticket to provision dedicated ingest lane; Felix -> INF-10021 for canary + config; Nora -> renewal scenarios and pilot offer; Iris -> backlog entry for dashboards/logging. I'll schedule enablement with LumenBridge ops once trial pool is ready. Renewal risk: medium until pilot validates predictability.

provision-bot: Dedicated ingest lane "lumenbridge-pilot-1" provisioned (expires in 10 days). Resources: 6 workers.

Felix (Eng-runtime): Deployed canary config to trial lane. Quick canary config suggestion:
```yaml
tenant: lumenbridge-search
backfill_route: lumenbridge-pilot-1
batch_size: 256
team_concurrency: {Search:5,AgentAssist:4}
kv_retention: extended
```
I'll post perf dashboard link in ~2h.

Tess (CSE): Great. Collecting pilot metrics (p50/p95/p99, 429 rate, cost delta) and customer feedback. Nora, loop me in on the renewal playbook. :thumbsup:
